verdict.rationale: Composio's CLI and docs let a developer inspect tool schemas and execute tools locally, and session/creation calls let you restrict to specific toolkits/allowed_tools and choose transport (SDK vs hosted MCP), which covers part of the 'inspect before connecting' story. However there's no evidence of a browsable registry listing per-server hosting attributes (e.g., self-hosted vs hosted, region, uptime) alongside transport and schema info prior to connection — discovery is mostly done at runtime via meta-tools or CLI rather than a pre-connect catalog view. missing for 10: a registry/catalog UI or API showing hosting attributes and transport per listed server, independent/hands-on confirmation of schema inspection workflow.
